title: 第310章 真当佛爷好欺负啊第309章 古修士
content_zh:
夜空之下，冷风呼啸。
面对萧逸的怒骂，五个留着长辫的古修士脸色铁青。
其中为首的一个上前一步，冷哼一声，“黄口小儿，休得猖狂！吾等……”
“我去你……废话可真多！”
还没等那古修士把场面话说完，悟德直接打断。
“跟这群脑子秀逗的古修士说个屁！”
他咆哮着冲出，身躯暴涨两圈，化作两米多高的巨人。
金色的佛门罡气自体内喷薄而出。
“唰！”
悟德左手现出暗金降魔杵，右手握紧破戒刀，面容凶恶，杀气腾腾。
“佛爷这就送你们去见佛祖忏悔！！！”
悟德怒吼着，手中的降魔杵势大力沉，朝着为首的古修士当头砸下，击穿空气，炸开气爆！
站在后方的萧逸看着进入狂暴状态的悟德，摇了摇头。
“哎，这死秃驴，脑子里就长了肌肉了。好不容易遇到个可以装逼的机会，这帮老古董连狠话都还没放完，逼都不让我装一装的，这多没情调啊。”
吐槽归吐槽，萧逸的手下可没闲着。
这里是西开市的近郊，如果放任这几个元婴期的大修士在半空中火拼，泄露出来的战斗余波，足以把下方的公路和周围的民房夷为平地。
这要是砸坏了花花草草，回局里老苏非得扣他们工资不可！
“给老子进来吧！”
萧逸抬手一扬！
“嗡！”

一枚阵盘脱手飞出，在半空炸开光幕。
光芒一闪，包括那五个古修士在内，连带萧逸和悟德，七人凭空消失！
等五个古修士回过神，发现自己已经不在原地。
七人出现在了一处巨大擂台上！
四周是翻滚的白雾，天上地下全被空间阵法壁垒死死封锁。
“这是何处？！”
“空间阵法？！”
五个古修士还没搞明白情况，一阵狂风扑面而来。
悟德根本不管这是哪，攻击已经杀到面前。
巨大的破戒刀带着刀芒，横扫而出！
“竖子敢尔！”
五人吓了一跳，匆忙从怀里掏出各自的法宝武器，有飞剑，有铜铃，有长鞭，齐刷刷地抵挡悟德这蛮不讲理的攻击。
就在五人将注意力集中在悟德身上的那一刹那，萧逸已悄然绕到他们身后！
content_en:
Under the night sky, the cold wind howled.
Facing Xiao Yi's scolding, the five ancient monks with long braids turned pale.
One of the leaders stepped forward and snorted coldly, "Young man with a yellow mouth, please stop being so arrogant! We..."
"Fuck you...there's so much nonsense!"
Before the ancient monk could finish describing the scene, Wude interrupted him directly.
"What the hell do you say to these funny-minded ancient monks!"
He roared and rushed out, his body suddenly expanded twice, turning into a giant more than two meters tall.
The golden Buddhist energy spurted out from the body.
"Uh-huh!"
A dark golden demonic pestle appears in Wude's left hand, and he holds a broken sword in his right hand, with a ferocious face and murderous intent.
"The Buddha will send you to see the Buddha to repent right now!!!"
Wude roared angrily, and the demon-subduing pestle in his hand hit the head of the leading ancient monk with great force, punching through the air and exploding with energy!
Xiao Yi, who was standing behind, looked at Wude who was entering a violent state and shook his head.
"Hey, this bald ass has grown muscles in his brain. It's not easy to find an opportunity to show off. These old antiques haven't even finished their harsh words and won't let me show off. How unsentimental it is."
Complaints are complaints, Xiao Yi's men are not idle.
This is the outskirts of Xikai City. If these Nascent Soul Stage monks are allowed to fight in mid-air, the aftermath of the battle will be enough to level the road below and the surrounding houses.
If they destroy the flowers and plants, Old Su will have to deduct their wages when they return to the bureau!
"Come in for me!"
Xiao Yi raised his hand!
"Buzz!"
An array disk flew out from his hands and exploded into a curtain of light in mid-air.
With a flash of light, seven people, including the five ancient monks, Xiao Yi and Wude, disappeared out of thin air!
When the five ancient monks came to their senses, they found that they were no longer where they were.
Seven people appeared on a huge arena!
Surrounded by billowing white mist, the sky and the earth were all blocked by space formation barriers.
"Where is this?!"
"Space formation?!"
Before the five ancient monks could understand the situation, a gust of wind blew in their faces.
Wu De didn't care where he was, the attack was already in front of him.
The huge ring-breaking sword swept out with its sword light!
"How dare you, Zhuzi!"
The five people were startled and hurriedly took out their magic weapons from their arms, including flying swords, copper bells, and long whips, and they all used them to resist Wude's unreasonable attack.
The moment the five people focused their attention on Wude, Xiao Yi had quietly walked around behind them!
